articles.title: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as criticism mounts after by-election defeat
articles.description: Jewish Greens' leader has said Polanski should resign in the wake of a Zionism row and by-election defeat.

articles.title: 'Deeply personal moment': Watch Sagal Abdi-Wali's by-election victory speech
articles.description: Labour beat the Green Party with 45% of the vote in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election.

articles.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
articles.description: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

articles.title: King pays Andrew's £1.5m repair bill on Royal Lodge
articles.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was charged £1.5m in repair and restoration costs after surrendering the lease on the 30-room mansion.
